notes_for_editor: Brief record checks out against the sources (1932 build, 595 m elevation, WDNR administration, standing). Access: the 2019 article says the fire tower is not open for climbing and that the observation tower beside it can be climbed; the Register says the adjacent wooden observation tower is open to the public. The story points visitors only to the public observation tower. Staffing and fire history are not in any source read. Not used: the Central Lookouts page carries an unsourced 1983 photo caption about the observation tower and Timms Hill Park, and an NGS description mentions a benchmark stamped 'OGEMA TOWER 1934'; Wikipedia's Timms Hill article says a public lookout tower is atop the hill without saying which one. The 1982 date comes from one survey history; the 1983 caption on the Central Lookouts page is not a source for this story.
